questions.question: The first modern Olympic Games was held in the year ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1896.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The International Olympic Committee (IOC) was founded in 1894, and it was decided that the first modern Olympic Games would be held two years later in Athens, Greece.**
 
• The first modern Olympic Games were held from **April 6 to April 15, 1896, and featured 14 nations and 241 athletes competing in 43 events.**
 
• The Games were a huge success and helped to revive the ancient tradition of** Olympic competition, which had been dormant for more than 1,500 years.**
 
• The modern Olympic Games have been held every four years since 1896, with the exception of 1916, 1940, and 1944 due to World War I and II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Olympic flag has a white background, with five interlaced rings in the centre: blue, yellow, black, green, and red.

 
 
• Each colour corresponds to a particular continent: blue for Europe, yellow for Asia, black for Africa, green for Australia and Oceania, and red for the Americas.
 
 
 
• The Olympic motto “Citius, Altius, Fortius” (“Faster, Higher, Stronger”) was coined by Father Henri Didon.
 
• Only three modern Olympic Games have been cancelled.
 
 
• The games were cancelled due to World War I (1914) and World War II (1940, 1944).
 
 
 
• The youngest Olympian is Greek gymnast Dimitrios Loundras, who competed in the 1896 Athens Olympics at the age of 10.

• Kathakali is a traditional dance-drama form from the southern state of Kerala that combines dance, music, and acting. It is known for its elaborate costumes, makeup, and facial expressions that are used to convey emotions and tell stories.

If things were not going to be normal / after the pandemic, mankind will / have to accept the New Normal.

options.text: have to accept the New Normal
If things were not going to be normal

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**If things were not going to be normal.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, the error lies in the part," If things were not going to be normal."**
 
• **The verb tense in this part of the sentence is incorrect. **
 
• **"Were" is in the past tense, while "will" is in the future tense.**
 
• The sentence is referring to a situation in future. 
 
• Thus, to maintain proper tense agreement, the correct version of this sentence would be:
 
 
• "If things are not going to be normal after the pandemic, mankind will have to accept the New Normal."
 
 

Thus, **the correct answer is option 3**.

questions.solution:

• The given sentence is in active form i.e. the action performed by the subject is expressed by the verb.
 
 
• Example: She(subject) wrote(verb) a letter(object).
 
 
 
• In passive voice, the the subject is acted upon by the verb or action in the sentence.
 
 
• The structure of sentence in passive voice is: Object+ verb+ subject.
 
 
 
• **The sentence is in active voice with the subject "Let me" performing the action of buying.**
 
• **To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object "an expensive bag" the subject and use the passive form of the verb "buy" (be + past participle).**
 
• The sentence in passive voice will have the structure: "Let an expensive bag be bought by me for my friend."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
